title: nx-gm1tl-sim: Verify iOS+watchOS push + action chain via Simulator (agent-doable)
description:
The simulator-coverage portion of nx-gm1tl. Agent-runnable end-to-end once nx-5eqal (provisioning) ships the bundle IDs + project.yml updates.

Coverage in Simulator (Xcode 14+ supports push to Simulator):
1. List iOS simulators: xcrun simctl list devices ios available
2. Boot iOS Simulator (latest iPhone, latest iOS): xcrun simctl boot <sim-id>
3. Install nexus-ios.app to sim: xcrun simctl install booted <build-output-path>/nexus-ios.app
4. Launch app: xcrun simctl launch booted dev.leonardoacosta.nexus.ios
5. Send simulated push to verify app handles payload:
   cat > /tmp/push.json << 'JSON'
   { 'aps': { 'alert': { 'title': 'Test', 'body': 'Hello from Nexus' }, 'category': 'nexus.permission' }, 'sessionId': 'sim-test' }
   JSON
   xcrun simctl push booted dev.leonardoacosta.nexus.ios /tmp/push.json
6. Verify notification appears in sim (programmatic: check ~/Library/Logs/CoreSimulator/<id>/system.log for UNNotification delivery)
7. Boot Watch Simulator: xcrun simctl list devices watchos available; xcrun simctl boot <watch-sim-id>
8. Run nexus-watch scheme via Xcode build → installs to paired watch sim
9. Send simulated push that targets the watch category — verify watch notification appears
10. Programmatically simulate the watch 'Continue' action — tap-action does NOT have a direct simctl call, but the NotificationActionRegistry handler can be invoked via UIApplication.shared.delegate path OR by re-firing the notification with action=continue payload
11. Verify nexus-agent log shows POST /commands/send-text + tmux receives keystrokes (check tmux session)

Closes: ~90% of original nx-gm1tl scope at sim-level confidence.

Does NOT exercise the real APNs round-trip (that path is genuinely hardware-bound; see sibling nx-gm1tl).

Depends on: nx-5eqal (fastlane provisioning ships bundle IDs).
close_reason: Sim verification COMPLETE 2026-05-18 after fixing 3 blockers (nx-axdqm SwiftUI import, nx-rui8k launchd env vars, nx-0jz3x watchOS 26.4 sim runtime). iOS + watch builds clean; simctl push delivers; /commands/send-text route smoke green. Two follow-on patches required during retry (committed in c50170f): @preconcurrency annotation on TerminalViewDelegate conformance + missing rangeChanged delegate stub; watch Info.plist WKWatchOnly false->true (sibling bundle IDs reject WKCompanionAppBundleIdentifier prefix check). nx-gm1tl is the only remaining hardware-bound work.

title: nx-gm1tl: Real-APNs round-trip + on-device visual verification (true hardware-bound)
description:
The TRULY hardware-bound portion of Apple ecosystem verification — the parts that simulators cannot test:

1. Real APNs round-trip: nexus-agent sends push using APNs Auth Key + Bundle ID → push arrives on PHYSICAL iPhone (over Wi-Fi or cellular). Simulator pushes via xcrun simctl bypass APNs entirely so cannot verify the agent→APNs→device path.

2. On-device visual UX confirmation: real device haptics + lock-screen rendering + Apple Watch face-up wrist-raise behavior. Subjective.

3. Real device pairing: Apple Watch sim auto-pairs with iOS sim in Xcode, but a physical Watch must be paired manually via iPhone's Watch app — no API exists.

4. Tailscale/cellular routing: physical iPhone on Tailscale can hit nexus-agent over the homelab tunnel; simulator on Mac shares host network. Different paths.

Steps (~30 min, requires Leo + iPhone + Apple Watch):
1. Install nexus-ios.ipa to iPhone via Xcode Devices window (sideloaded with dev profile from nx-5eqal)
2. Send test push from nexus-agent via the APNs Auth Key configured in nx-5eqal → confirm push arrives on iPhone (visual)
3. Pair Apple Watch with iPhone via iPhone's Watch app (no API)
4. Sideload nexus-watch.app to paired Watch
5. Trigger notification from nexus-agent → confirm arrival on Watch (visual) → tap 'Continue' action → confirm tmux receives keystrokes

Coverage: ~10% of original nx-gm1tl scope. Sibling nx-gm1tl-sim covers the other ~90% in simulators.

Blocked by: nx-5eqal (provisioning) + nx-gm1tl-sim (sim-level confidence before burning device time).

title: nx-gsgvk-cli: Provision iOS+watchOS via fastlane + ASC API (CLI part)
description:
The agent-doable portion of nx-gsgvk Apple Dev provisioning. Depends on Leo providing an ASC API key (one-time human step at App Store Connect website → Users and Access → Keys → Generate API Key → download .p8 + record Key ID + Issuer ID).

Once ASC key exists at ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8, agent dispatches fastlane workflow:
1. brew install fastlane (~50MB, 2 min)
2. cd apps/swift/nexus-ios && fastlane init (configure with team DX3Y367L2A + ASC key)
3. fastlane produce -u <apple_id> --app_identifier dev.leonardoacosta.nexus.ios --app_name 'Nexus iOS' --skip_itc — creates Bundle ID
4. fastlane pem -p <bundle_id> — generates APNs .p8 Auth Key, writes to apps/swift/nexus-ios/AuthKey_<id>.p8
5. fastlane sigh -a <bundle_id> --output_path apps/swift/nexus-ios/profiles/ — downloads provisioning profile
6. Update apps/swift/project.yml: add push entitlement to nexus-ios target's CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS
7. Wire APNs .p8 + Key ID + Team ID into nexus-agent config (env vars in deploy/install.sh or ~/.config/nexus/secrets.env)
8. Repeat steps 2-7 for nexus-watch bundle ID dev.leonardoacosta.nexus.watch
9. (Optional CI sanity) install pusher CLI: brew install kong/kong/pusher; verify .p8 + bundle ID work via test send (no device required for the send itself)

Coverage: 70% of original nx-gsgvk scope. Excluded: device pairing (nx-gsgvk-hw) + visual on-device verification (nx-gsgvk-hw).

Blocker: needs Leo to create ASC API key (10 min one-time at App Store Connect website). Once key is in ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/, agent can run end-to-end.

title: Refine A9 (unhandled Promise rejection) to recognize chain-terminal .catch() and safeFireAndForget wrapper
description:
A9 rule flags `.then()` at line N even when:

1. A `.catch()` terminates the same chain later (e.g. `import().then(A).catch(B).then(C).catch(D)` \u2014 rule flags C because it sees `.then()` without adjacent `.catch()`)
2. The entire promise expression is wrapped by a helper like `safeFireAndForget(p, ctx)` that adds its own `.catch()`

Currently suppressed via .audit-suppressions.json for apps/agent/src/session-manager.ts + apps/agent/src/watcher-bridge.ts.

Refine the A9 detector to:
- Walk chained method calls and consider a chain safe if ANY `.catch()` appears before the chain terminates at a statement boundary
- Recognize known wrapper calls (`safeFireAndForget(...)`) as adding error handling
- Optionally: two-arg `.then(onOk, onErr)` form

Once refined, remove the A9 entry from .audit-suppressions.json.
